title: Bitwarden Store app data
whyItMatters: The Microsoft Store version of Bitwarden keeps an encrypted vault, account state and logs in its package folder. The folder shows a password manager was used on this PC.
source: Bitwarden Help, Data Storage: Microsoft Store data at %LocalAppData%/Packages/8bitSolutionsLLC.bitwardendesktop_h4e712dmw3xyy/LocalCache/Roaming/Bitwarden - https://bitwarden.com/help/data-storage/
notes: Microsoft Store build. The standard installer uses %APPDATA%/Bitwarden instead. Vault data is encrypted; nothing is opened or decrypted.

cleanup.exportFirst: Open Bitwarden and export a copy of every vault you need, then check that the exported file opens before removing anything.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of Bitwarden on this PC, then in the web vault deauthorize this device's session so the account no longer trusts it.
steps: Confirm the vault export opens and you know the master password.
Sign out of Bitwarden on this PC.
Uninstall Bitwarden from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the Bitwarden folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes the encrypted vault and settings from this PC. Without a working export or account access, the vault items here cannot be recovered.
